infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Telomy connects to your ECG band over Bluetooth to show your live ECG, heart rate and HRV, and to sync recordings.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Telomy connects to your Telomy server on this Wi-Fi network to save your ECG, heart rate and HRV.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Telomy reads steps, activity, workouts, sleep and vitals from Apple Health to build your daily scores. Telomy never writes to Health.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Telomy does not write to Apple Health.

plugins.microphonePermission: Telomy uses the microphone when you talk to Sinc — to log meals, events and activities by voice and, if you allow it, to estimate stress from voice tone. Audio is never stored.
